messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance - Sat 17 Jan
messages.plaintextBody: The DMS will be unavailable from 22:00 Saturday 17 January to 04:00 Sunday 18 January for scheduled maintenance and indexing upgrades. Please check in any documents before the window. Contact the helpdesk with any urgent access needs.
